Part of the Dioriviera capsule, the House's Dior Oblique motif is reimagined through Jonathan Anderson's modern vision in a mix of textures and weaving for a lightweight spongy effect. Thanks to its adjustable and removable leather strap and top handle completed by a CD buckle, the pouch can be carried by hand, worn on the shoulder or crossbody.
